scope: Read-only repair design review of all 14 product Dialog call sites in 12 product files; no repeated whole-web audit, source edits or full tests.

callSemantics.behavior: Project, rename, branch and review close callbacks are vetoed by running.current; forced modal release cannot depend on invoking them.
Close clears preview and revokes Blob URL. AttachmentButton remains mounted during auth loss, so its mounted guard permits delayed attachment/read completion to mount Dialog.
Other dialogs delegate closure to parent setters. Existing App auth-loss reset unmounts top-level dialogs; generic availability must cover retained descendant dialogs outside that block.

requiredBoundaries: Cover the entire retained Workspace including Composer/AttachmentButton and delayed descendant mounts; unavailable Dialog must never call showModal.
Release native modal ownership and document keyboard listeners synchronously with availability loss, independently of business onClose and in-flight vetoes.
Do not remount Workspace or clear useDraft/receipt state; no replay on authentication recovery. Preserve BranchDialog draft/created-branch identity behavior and normal close guards.
Do not restore focus into hidden/inert workspace or steal Login autofocus. Normal close restores connected visible opener/fallback. Distinguish attachment suspension from Blob disposal.
Preserve IME Escape/isComposing/keyCode229 behavior and Tab containment when available. Inactive dialogs cannot intercept login keys; multiple active dialogs must not consume the same Escape/Tab.
Validate open preview at auth loss and late attachment/read response after loss, login keyboard access, draft retention, no replay, and explicit reauthentication behavior.
coordination: Design constraints sent directly to root and fresh_r11_interface. Final implementation inspected only after interface explicitly stopped source writes. No source edits by reviewer.

finalImplementationReview.verdict: No additional confirmed blocking issue in the repaired scope.
conclusions: DialogScope composes parentActive && active and wraps all retained Workspace descendants. Inactive/late Dialog mounts never enter native modal state or install keyboard listeners.

useLayoutEffect cleanup releases modal and keyboard ownership without invoking business onClose, preserving the existing in-flight vetoes, retained draft/receipt state and explicit top-level App modal reset.

Stable render-time owner order is retained across scope suspension; setup sorts registrations and reopens higher layers so child-first React layout effects do not place the outer native dialog above its inner dialog.

Only the last registered layer consumes Escape/Tab; composition handling is preserved. Cleanup removes its layer and skips custom focus restoration during unavailability or lower-layer removal. Normal restoration filters hidden/closed ancestors and respects the remaining modal.
New regressions cover nested Escape/Tab, StrictMode registration/cleanup, scope suspension/reopen, hidden opener/fallbacks and both open and delayed attachment previews across auth loss.

Reauthentication intentionally restores retained attachment previews, including a delayed response accepted while inactive. Existing top-level App dialogs remain reset. Blob URL is retained during suspension and revoked on explicit preview close; attachment/read and mutation requests are not replayed.

tests.authorReported: Four exact affected test files: 48 passed; web TypeScript check passed. Reviewer read the two changed regression files but did not repeat successful test runs.

limitations: Native showModal/close and stacking are mocked in jsdom; no real browser top-layer/inert or physical IME acceptance was executed by this reviewer.
Read-only focused repair review, not a new complete frozen audit round. Historical round11 report was not modified.
